top_categories.workout_context: Leuven Legacy Gravel's rolling Brabantse Wouden gravel outside Leuven rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Leuven Legacy Gravel's Brabantse Wouden forest gravel, UCI Gravel World Series forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 82 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Leuven Legacy Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Leuven Legacy Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 82, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At Leuven Legacy Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on rolling Brabantse Wouden gravel outside Leuven, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Leuven Legacy Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 82 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Leuven Legacy Gravel's rolling Brabantse Wouden gravel outside Leuven actually does to you.
Varied gradients on rolling Brabantse Wouden gravel outside Leuven demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling Brabantse Wouden gravel outside Leuven. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Leuven Legacy Gravel’s 82 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Leuven Legacy Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rolling brabantse wouden gravel outside leuven to build confidence. Expect: brabantse wouden forest gravel, uci gravel world series, leuven's 2024 worlds setting.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 82 miles of rolling brabantse wouden gravel outside leuven in Leuven / Heverlee, Flemish Brabant, Belgium.
